plan.primary: im3 versus off; im2 is prespecified sensitivity. All 27 searches retained.
plan.model: Compatible 100-feature Sequoia tree model trained on public measured CCS. No HYE evaluation-run labels used for fitting.
plan.calibration: A1 used only for error-width estimation; each searched run gets the original gate's unsupervised per-charge median obs/pred scale from its candidate pool.
plan.evaluation: Whole tied-binomial-score blocks, expanded same-species accessions; absent Arabidopsis count / present HYE count times FASTA HYE/Arabidopsis size, at 1%, 3%, 5%. Also internal q<=1% lists and per-file Sage corroboration.
plan.decision: Call a consistent gain only if the primary arm improves median 1% depth in each of the three files and improves at least seven of nine paired searches; otherwise report mixed/no benefit. No parameter tuning after results.
plan.limitations: One timsTOF Ultra 2 HYE dataset, three evaluation acquisitions and three seeds. MS/MS corroboration is not a complete truth set. Entapment thresholds are retrospective, not deployable q-values. No paper update.
plan.amendment: Before any completed identification results, the bundled model was found to expect 70 inputs while the encoder emits 100. The two in-flight jobs were interrupted and archived separately. Replacement model training is fixed at depth 5, 300 trees, learning rate 0.1, seed 42, on public corpus training sequences only. All evaluation files, search seeds, filter widths, thresholds, and decision criteria remain unchanged.

matching_defaults.reason: Setup correction: --features does not apply the existing --raw Bruker defaults. Ungated runs collapsed to empty outputs, so they cannot assess IM under the standard supported workflow. Both paired arms now explicitly use matching.min_isotopes=4 and matching.min_combined_score=0.85, copied exactly from main at paper-2026-09-13 (crates/uno/src/main.rs). These thresholds were not selected from this experiment.
matching_defaults.unchanged: Model, IM widths, raw data, extracted features, database, seeds, arms, primary decision rule and all other settings unchanged. Restart all 27 planned searches; preserve all unfiltered completed and interrupted attempts separately.

public_model.split: SHA256 uno-im-public-v1:sequence modulo 10; bucket 0 external validation; group by sequence, all charge states together.
public_model.label: CCS * sqrt(mass * 28.0134 / (mass + 28.0134)) / charge / 1000; proportional inverse mobility; dataset-specific multiplicative calibration is required.
public_model.chemistry: Unmodified sequences with fixed carbamidomethyl C; measured mass within 0.02 Da of that chemistry; lengths 7-30, charges 2-4; replicate medians.
public_model.training_command: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=8 OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 uno-rt-train --labels model/train.csv --im-labels model/train.csv --out model/im_public.sequoia --sequoia --max-depth 5 --iterations 300 --shrinkage 0.1

loader_parity.change: Sequoia width guard added after study binary freeze; valid model predictions unchanged.

conclusion: No consistent benefit from the primary or sensitivity IM gate; keep experimental and do not alter the submission paper.
